selection: First Airbnb run in the repository, after verifying Uber, Qualcomm and TSMC. The Nov 5 Q3 shareholder letter was the newest quarterly release on the issuer IR page at the Nov 7 Sydney cutoff. Input PDF downloaded directly from the investor page. The engine was frozen before issuer selection. Gold values annotated from the original PDF without running the application on the issuer. No retuning/rerolling the blind.
rubric: A01–A14 count only a first end-to-end answer giving the requested period (including TTM versus quarter), metric, scope, accurate value, currency/unit or exact equivalent, and a verbatim supporting original row or passage on a preregistered physical page. A13 must identify a forecast and include both amount endpoints. A14 must identify a full-year forecast of about 36 percent, not the Q3 actual margin. A07 is a count, not currency. A15–A16 require explicit period-end and research date and no monetary guess. A17–A18 require evidence-insufficient status with no implied non-disclosure or invented amount. Report 14 numerical/guidance cases separately from the two future and two missing cases. Score infrastructure errors as such if any occur.
